errors: Small duplicate-load window: getAsync releases the lock on a miss before putIfAbsent, so a thread can miss just as another load installs and removes its inflight future, then start a second load (an extra DB call, not a stale value)
A.note: Complete, verifiable design: access-order LinkedHashMap plus a lazily cleaned expiry heap, so expired entries are evicted before LRU ones; the load runs off-lock and is collapsed, put beats a stale load atomically under the lock, and the tests are strong.
